description: Local keyword research: how many times a month people in one city search for the terms you give, and for the closest related searches, from Google’s own counts. Each answer lists the terms asked first, then up to 50 related ones, most searched first, each with searchesPerMonth (null when too few to count), competition among advertisers (low, medium, high), adClickPrice (what an advertiser pays for one click, in US dollars: a sign of how much the search is worth) and the last 12 months as trend. Use it when choosing topics: give the business’s main products or services in the customer’s words and the city from the brand, then take the strongest terms as topic keywords (topics_add). Each call uses one of the plan’s lookups for the month (Studio 20, Pro 200; usage_get says how many are left under keywords). Lookups are kept: read one again with keywords_list instead of asking twice.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

language.description: The language people search in: en (English) or es (Spanish). English when left out.

place.description: The city the business serves, with its state or country, such as "Austin, Texas" or "Bogotá, Colombia". A state or a whole country works too, with fewer local numbers.

terms.description: One to 10 search terms in the words a customer would type, such as "wedding flowers" or "florist". At most 80 characters and 10 words each, no emoji.

name: keywords_research
title: Research local keywords
